meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 收到审查请求后,Claude 会同时启动 5 个后台子代理,分别检查目标完成度、代码质量和安全性,实际运行验证,并翻查 GitHub、Slack 等来源。只有全部通过,审查才通过;任一失败即失败。
howto.when: 当你说“review work”“check my work”等要求复查已完成的工作,或在 PR 交接前要求审查时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude launches 5 parallel background sub-agents covering goal check, code quality, and security plus live QA and context mining. The review passes only if all 5 pass; any failure fails the review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to review completed work (e.g., "review my work", "check my work") or before a PR handoff.

say_en.text: Review this branch before I open a PR.
say_en.note: Collects changes and run command, then reviews in parallel.

say_en.text: Verify my implementation matches the original request.
say_en.note: Focuses on goal and constraint compliance.
